prediction_vs_result.prediction: Written before any incoming, added or comparison term exists. (1) What a merge adds recurs. Over places 168 to 201, where 460c3ebb read the state difference in left-out answers, at each of the three merges the deals read (layer 0's attention, layer 17's attention, the last merge): read along the other wrong answers' own added parts, a left-out wrong answer's added part lies over a left-out correct answer's in a larger share of the pairs than any of the twelve deals gives at that merge and stretch, and in more than half of the pairs with the same m, v and drop. (2) Most of the difference is carried, not made at the merge. Along the outgoing direction, the incoming term's mean projection for the left-out wrong answers is the largest of the three terms at most of the 105 merges, over places 168 to 201: a merge adds a small part to a state that carries every earlier one. (3) Where it grows at the row that writes the sign. At place 168 the left-out wrong answers' part of the common direction rises between layer 0 and layer 12 (460c3ebb). Among the merges of layers 0 to 12 at which their mean outgoing projection is larger than their mean incoming one, the added term's mean projection is positive and larger than the comparison term's at more merges than not, and larger than the left-out correct answers' mean added projection at more merges than not. No prediction is made of how much the bounds leave unresolved in the added and comparison terms: kappa has not been computed on these recordings, and where it leaves most pairs unresolved or the term undetermined, that is the result for those cells.

result.1_what_a_merge_adds_recurs: Holds at the 2 of the three named merges that can be read (attention-17 and layer-34); the third cannot be read. Layer 0's attention: no reading. The term is undetermined at every place of the window (the share of references for which the incoming features do not fix the coefficients is 1.00): the embedding's rows of answers that read the same token are the same row, so the nearest mixture of them is one of many and what the merge adds beyond it is not one vector. The outgoing state there is determined and separates the left-out answers in 0.9629 of the pairs (0.9572 of the 46 matched), over every one of the twelve deals (their greatest 0.5867). Layer 17's attention: holds. Read along the other wrong answers' own added parts, a left-out wrong answer's added part lies over a left-out correct answer's in 0.9985 of the pairs (0.9985 resolved over, 0.0015 resolved under) and in 0.9955 of the 46 pairs with the same m, v and drop; the twelve deals give 0.3744 to 0.6301 (median 0.5328, the farthest from one half 0.1301), 12 of them under this run's. The last merge (layer 34, the per-layer embedding's part): holds. Read along the other wrong answers' own added parts, a left-out wrong answer's added part lies over a left-out correct answer's in 0.8471 of the pairs (0.8470 resolved over, 0.1528 resolved under) and in 0.8523 of the 46 pairs with the same m, v and drop; the twelve deals give 0.4608 to 0.5818 (median 0.5015, the farthest from one half 0.0818), 12 of them under this run's.
result.2_carried_or_made: Over places 168 to 201, of the 104 merges at which the terms are determined, the incoming term is the largest of the three along the outgoing direction at 78, the added term at 26 and the comparison term at 0: the count the prediction names holds. Its reason, that a merge adds a small part, holds for a layer's last merge and for the late layers only. The added term is the left-out wrong answers' largest at 22 of the 35 feed-forward merges, at 4 of the 34 determined attention merges and at 0 of the 35 last merges of a layer. As a part of the outgoing projection (the median over the merges of a kind): attention adds 0.267, the feed-forward 0.568, a layer's last merge 0.004; the change of the comparison point makes 0.003, 0.006 and 0.000 of it. Layer by layer the feed-forward's part is over one half at 22 of the 35 layers, the last of them layer 24: through that layer its median is 0.631 and attention's 0.345; after it the feed-forward adds 0.201 to 0.386 and attention 0.017 to 0.067. A layer's output is its last merge times the layer's output scale (0.0178 to 0.871; 0.695 or more after layer 24). My reading of why, which is no measurement: through layer 24 a layer starts from a state made smaller while what its matrices add keeps its own size, so the two matrix merges write a large part of the difference again, and the layers after it mostly carry it.
result.3_at_the_row_that_writes_the_sign: Holds. At place 168, of the 38 determined merges of layers 0 to 12 the left-out wrong answers' outgoing projection is larger than their incoming one at 35. Among those the added term is positive and larger than the comparison term at 31 and not at 4 (attention-1, layer-12, layer-4, layer-6); it is larger than the left-out correct answers' mean added projection at 31 and not at 4 (attention-1, layer-11, layer-12, layer-4).

failures_only.layer_0_attention_has_no_added_reading: One of the three merges prediction (1) names cannot be read: at layer 0's attention the incoming, added and comparison terms are undetermined at every place, because the comparison is fixed on the embedding's rows and those do not fix it. The declaration said such a cell is its own result. It leaves the model's largest single contribution (the first attention's part is nearly the whole state after it) without an inherited/added split.
failures_only.the_reason_of_prediction_2: The declaration expected a merge to add a small part to a state that carries every earlier one. That is so after layer 24 and at every layer's last merge. Through layer 24 it is the other way at the feed-forward, whose part is more than half of the left-out wrong answers' outgoing projection at 22 layers. The declaration named this case: there the difference is made again at each layer and not only carried, which weakens its reason for the first repeating pattern, not the hypothesis.
failures_only.where_the_comparison_carries_the_growth: At the row that writes the sign the growth is not the added term's at 4 of the 35 merges that grow: attention-1, layer-12, layer-4, layer-6. At layer 1's attention the change of the comparison point is the largest part; the others are last merges of a layer, where almost nothing is added.
failures_only.the_tokens_written: Added after the map was seen and named by no prediction (section 12 of the read). Where the difference is largest the two groups do not always write the same text, so it was counted: over places 172 to 201 a wrong and a correct answer write the same token at a place in 0.753 of the pairs and places (two wrong answers in 0.785, two correct ones in 0.812), over the heading (149 to 159) in 0.293, and at place 168 in 0.000: at the row that writes the sign no wrong answer writes a token a correct answer writes (0 of the 900 pairs; two wrong answers write the same one in 0.933 of their pairs, two correct ones in 0.754), so there this reading cannot be told from the token written. Over places 172 to 201 it can. In each answer's own mean reading, a wrong answer lies over a correct answer that writes the same token in 0.993 of the pairs and places for the outgoing state at attention (0.985 where they write different tokens), and for what the merge adds in 0.986 at attention, 0.983 at the feed-forward and 0.917 at a layer's last merge (0.967, 0.957 and 0.850 where they write different tokens). The answers lie apart at least as much where they write the same token. These are the answers' means over their pairs, not each pair's own value, which the map did not keep pair by pair.
failures_only.derived_not_recorded: A matrix merge's contribution is rebuilt from its recorded input (the rebuilt merge's size agrees with the engine's to 4.5e-06 and the rebuilt outgoing state with the recorded one to 2.0e-06); a layer's last merge's contribution is the difference of two states; the last layer's outgoing state is its recorded direction times its recorded size; the output norm is no addition and has features only.
failures_only.resolved_shares_are_not_repeatable_to_th: Beside 460c3ebb's array the ordered shares are the same at every place and step (0) and the projections agree to 1e-08, but the shares resolved over and under differ by up to 0.014 and 0.006 at a place: a search's bound differs in its last digits from run to run, and a pair at the edge changes sides.
failures_only.deals_at_four_steps: The observed level of no difference exists at layer 0's attention, layer 17's attention, the last merge and the output step only, as declared.
failures_only.weaker_before_the_heading: Before the places the prediction names the added part recurs less. At layer 17's attention its own reading is 0.687 over places 3 to 19, 0.735 over 20 to 75 and 0.843 over 76 to 148, against the deals' greatest 0.638, 0.606 and 0.648; at the last merge 0.546, 0.603 and 0.650 against 0.576, 0.582 and 0.592, with 10 of the 12 deals under it over places 3 to 19. Early in the answer what the last merge adds is not told from a random deal.

what_this_changes.what_was_asked: Astra's hypothesis for this reading: some of the reproducible late state discrepancy is associated with what a transformation adds, rather than being only an inherited state contrast or a changing nearest comparison point.
what_this_changes.what_the_recordings_say: It is. With the incoming comparison held fixed through each merge, what attention and the feed-forward add differs between left-out wrong and left-out correct answers in the direction the other wrong answers' added parts have in common: over places 168 to 201 in 0.980 and 0.977 of the pairs (the mean over the merges of a kind; 0.975 and 0.971 of the 46 matched pairs), with 0.0002 and 0.0001 of the pairs left unresolved by the bounds. The changing comparison point is not what makes the difference: it carries 0.003 to 0.006 of the outgoing projection. And the difference is not only inherited: at 22 of the 35 feed-forward merges, the last of them layer 24, what the merge adds is more than half of the left-out wrong answers' outgoing projection; the last 10 layers mostly carry it.
what_this_changes.answer_by_answer: Over places 168 to 201, each answer's added term along the other wrong answers' own added parts (its mean over the thirty references): of the 104 determined merges a wrong answer lies over every correct answer at a median 101 merges, the least 86 (discovery-05-channel-h3), and over the correct answers' median at 101 or more; a correct answer lies under every wrong answer at a median 101, the least 89 (discovery-23-channel-h3).
what_this_changes.what_the_bounds_leave: Over places 168 to 201, the share of the pairs a term's bound leaves unresolved (the mean over the merges of a kind; attention, the feed-forward, a layer's last merge): the added term 0.0002, 0.0001 and 0.0023; the comparison term 0.0054, 0.0028 and 0.0340; the outgoing state 0.0000, 0.0000 and 0.0000.
what_this_changes.the_features_and_the_output_norm: The same split of the features (direction and log size jointly, the frozen reference's weights) is no raw contribution and is kept apart: over places 168 to 201 the part made through the merge with the coefficients held fixed is 0.072 at attention and 0.406 at the feed-forward, against 0.267 and 0.568 added in the raw states. The output norm is no addition and has no raw terms: there 0.948 of the outgoing feature projection is the norm's own change of the features, so the split at that step describes the norm, not a contribution.
what_this_changes.what_it_does_not_say: A merge's response to an input that already differs is also what it adds, so this is no label of input against error and no correction mask (the declaration's scope, Astra's specification). At the row that writes the sign no wrong and correct answer write the same token, so there the difference cannot be told from the text; over places 172 to 201 they write the same token in 0.753 of the pairs and places and lie apart as much there as elsewhere. Sixty answers of one template.
what_this_changes.for_the_correction_objective_fables_read: A request written on a merge's outgoing state asks that one matrix to answer for the whole outgoing difference. By this split, 0.728 of it at an attention merge and 0.429 at a feed-forward merge (the medians over the layers) came in with the state, and each later matrix adds its own part. The split is on record per merge, place and answer (map/, archived), so a request that asks a matrix only for what it adds differently, with the incoming comparison held fixed, can be read from these arrays without a new recording. Whether that is the right request is the objective's question and Astra's to assess; nothing here selects a model, a ridge, a dose or a threshold.
what_this_changes.beside_it: runs/same-prefix-135-original/result.json reads five answers that write the same text up to one decision, the comparison this run cannot make. There the three answers that decide the right way carry nearly as much of the recurring difference as their two wrong siblings, and what tells the kinds apart is small, sits at the deciding row and first shows at feedforward-19: carrying the recurring difference from the correct reference is not by itself deciding wrong.
